prompt:
Use case: style-transfer, identity-preserve.
Edit target image 1: the latest campfire banner. Image 2 is the exact protagonist sprite and identity authority.
Redraw image 1 into a more AIRY, FLOWING, ELEGANT hand-inked Chinese game illustration. Keep the same identifiable young hero, costume, bamboo travel basket, modest campfire and 3:1 panoramic banner purpose, but change stiff pose, composition and brush rhythm. Preserve exact thick eyebrows, topknot, face shape, brown short jacket, grey-blue clothing and leg wraps from image 2.
The seated hero feels at ease after a journey: slightly reclined torso with a gentle diagonal, one knee raised and the other leg loosely extended; one forearm rests naturally across the raised knee, the other hand lightly supports him on a plain rock. Hands anatomically clear. Gaze softly toward the little campfire. Asymmetry, calm looseness, subtle wind in the brown hair ribbon and jacket hem, NOT heroic action and NOT sitting stiffly with two identical hands on two identical knees.
A single slender tapering smoke brushstroke rises from the small fire in a loose S curve drifting left; fire and smoke remain modest and clear, not elaborate magic swirls. Three simple logs and two or three broad orange flame shapes. Basket behind him, one green bamboo pole gently tilted.
Replace straight stacked horizontal hills with just TWO broad loose grey-green ink mountain washes, offset asymmetrically, interrupted by large quiet areas of warm ivory. No continuous hard horizon line across the full image. Mountain edges vary from a few confident strokes into soft lost edges. One minimal tree can remain far left if it helps rhythm, no round lollipop canopy. Sparse grass in only two or three broad tapered ink strokes.
CRITICAL STYLE: same Chinese cartoon game character, confidently drawn with VARIABLE-WIDTH dark brown brush contours: strong at weight and folds, lighter/broken at light-facing edges, elegant taper at stroke ends. Simple broad matte colors, 2 or 3 tonal blocks per object. NOT clean vector uniform outlines; NOT realistic watercolor painting. Remove 80 percent of the repetitive mottled/crumpled-paper texture currently covering the whole frame. Paper almost smooth warm ivory with only faint natural grain.
Composition should breathe: character and fire readable at small size, flowing diagonal rhythm, generous empty space, no hard rectangular scenic frame. At left/right/bottom the landscape fades naturally into near-unmarked warm paper through broad sparse brushwork. Keep all character limbs, basket and campfire within the banner. 3:1 wide, no text, no UI, no border.
Avoid: excessive smoke, ink splatter, glitter, dense grass, gravel, rock cracks, hatching, tiny vegetation, fine wicker detail, fragmented drybrush noise, sharp outlines around every background object, thick uniform vector outlines, dramatic cinematic lighting, realism, extra accessories, sentimental baby face. Airiness must come from line rhythm, relaxed pose and empty paper, not from more decorative detail.
